flags.why: Frying bánh bao produces a fried bun, not a separate kind of round dumpling ([examples](https://www.foody.vn/bai-viet/ha-noi/banh-bao-ngon-10078)).
flags.fix: fried bun (a fried version of bánh bao)

flags.why: The entry omits the common meaning of a front or cover used to conceal something ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/b%C3%ACnh_phong)).
flags.fix: noun | front; cover (a person or thing used to conceal something)

flags.why: Calling Khmer people Miên can be derogatory, regardless of whether they live in Cambodia or Vietnam ([usage guidance](https://www.impe-qn.org.vn/dan-toc-thieu-so/nguoi-dan-toc-khmer/ctmb/43/4295)).
Miên refers to Khmer people generally and does not specifically mean Khmer Krom ([usage guidance](https://tudien.dolenglish.vn/nguoi-mien-tieng-anh-la-gi)).
flags.fix: Merge with sense 1: Khmer; Cambodian [dated, derogatory].

flags.why: Ngòi meaning a small stream remains in current use and is not archaic.
